Exactly three star-shaped pastel cake toppers on thin wooden sticks inserted into icing, colored sage green, pale yellow and soft pink. Preserve topper identity; no flame or writing. Coherent elliptical top and plate, no white sticker border.

One compact bunch of plump purple grapes tapering downward, rounded overlapping berries in lavender and plum shades with restrained shiny highlights. Short curved brown-green stem and one attached lobed green grape leaf at upper right. Clear connected bunch, no floating berries or extra fruit.
